get.description: Completes one OIDC login or link flow using the query state and callback-only HttpOnly cookies. Login credentials are returned once in JSON and never placed in a redirect URL.
Starts a public OIDC login and redirects to the configured provider. State, nonce, and S256 PKCE bind the one-time flow; nonce and verifier are held only in Secure HttpOnly callback cookies.
